title: Vetted sources
description: The canonical list of sources this project draws on. Generates FOUR renderings that were previously maintained by hand and had already drifted apart: the source chips above Ask Pelham, the 'Our Sources' list in About, the footer source line (which omitted Westchester County), and the vetted-source list at the top of the AI system prompt. This list is load-bearing for the assistant -- it defines what the model is permitted to draw on -- so adding an entry widens the AI's allowed sources and is not a cosmetic change.

$schema.description: Relative path to this schema file.

sources.description: DISPLAY ORDER IS ARRAY ORDER, for the chips, the About list and the footer alike.

name.description: Display name, e.g. 'Village of Pelham Manor' or 'Pelham Examiner'.

domain.description: Bare domain as printed on the chips and in the prompt, e.g. 'pelhammanor.gov'. No scheme, no trailing slash.

url.description: Full URL used for links. Kept separate from domain because the chips print the bare domain while the links need the scheme and any www prefix.

description.description: The parenthetical shown after the domain in the system prompt and after the arrow in the About list, e.g. 'Village of Pelham official site'.

governing_body.description: Foreign key to bodies.json id where this source IS a governing body's official site. Null for news sources. Lets the build cross-check that every governing body's website appears here.

civic_source.description: True for a civic or news source that is NOT a government body's own site -- the Pelham Examiner is the only one today. Flagged because the assistant must treat it differently: the Examiner honesty rule in prompt-template.md forbids implying the model has searched its archive, and RAG hits against it are attributed rather than stated as record.

in_prompt.description: Whether this source appears in the generated system prompt's vetted-source list. Default true. Setting false keeps a source on the page without widening what the AI may draw on.

short_name.description: Compact label used after the arrow in the About > Our Sources list, e.g. 'School District' for the Pelham Union Free School District. Falls back to `name`.
